topic: Sharp reference-mixture vaccine-waning bounds under changing pathogen variants. Derive the exact joint-history transport compression, sharp reciprocal endpoints, compatible-law certificates, pooled-sign frontier, and whole-set confidence projection; exposure margins are external primitives and case-strain frequencies are not substitutes. The presolve capsule and exact LP kill test are embedded in the queue anchor.

open_problems.open_problem: Under two calendar periods and changing pathogen variants, what is the sharp identified set for policy-fixed reference-mixture challenge-effect waning when trial risks and external period-specific exposure margins are known but the cross-period joint exposure history is latent?

source_refs.claim: Derives sharp two-period bounds for a single-pathogen challenge effect, without changing variant mixtures or latent joint variant-exposure histories.
source_refs.author: Matias Janvin and Mats J. Stensrud
source_refs.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

source_refs.claim: Allows waning efficacy and time-varying pathogen distributions through a marked exposure-process model, rather than sharp bounds from external margins.
source_refs.author: Dean Follmann and Chiung-Yu Huang

source_refs.claim: Shows that multi-variant vaccine-effectiveness measures can vary over time even without biological waning.
source_refs.author: Anirudh Tomer and Jorne Biccler

source_refs.excerpt: the single branch-free exact-mass partial-transport polytope is the exact projection of compatible laws
identify the complete joint threshold-value set; compute support functions, pairwise worst-case regret

open_problems.why_unsolved: The published literatures separate the necessary ingredients: Janvin–Stensrud obtain sharp survivor-selection bounds without variant replacement, Follmann–Huang permit time-varying strain distributions under a specified marked-process model, and Tomer–Biccler establish that variant aggregation alone can create temporal movement. The prior transport proposals show how an exact reduced polytope can equal the projection of compatible laws and why products of separately sharp intervals can overstate a common-law joint image. For vaccine waning, the first proof step that changes is the projection: infection-selected variant histories must be coupled to independently supplied exposure margins, with all time-by-variant coordinates preserved. Sharp reciprocal optimization is insufficient unless every reduced extremizer can be lifted to one compatible vaccination, exposure, infection, strain, and outcome law.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An equality between the full compatible-law projection and an explicit finite joint-history transport polytope, exact reciprocal-risk endpoints for reference-mixture waning, and endpoint-attaining full-law certificates.

writing_exemplar.why: Its motivation moves from the failure of naive early-versus-late comparisons to a controlled-exposure estimand and then to sharp partial identification.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Early and late observed effectiveness compare different survivor populations -> a challenge effect isolates protection under controlled exposure -> changing variants require a reference-mixture challenge effect with sharp joint-history transport bounds.

method_exemplars.technique: Enumerate latent response types, optimize the causal functional over their probability simplex, and prove sharpness by constructing laws at optimizing vertices.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired history model is likewise a finite latent-law polytope whose endpoints require both optimization and attainable-law certificates.

method_exemplars.technique: Use weighted estimating equations for time-varying strain distributions and derive their asymptotic distribution under a marked exposure process.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its time-varying strain and exposure inputs are the closest estimation analogue for the plug-in risks and external-margin components of the sharp set.

open_problems.open_problem: What necessary and sufficient conditions make substitution of observed case-strain frequencies for external exposure-variant margins harmless for the sharp reference-mixture waning set, and what is the sharp nonidentification or distortion frontier otherwise?

source_refs.claim: Distinguishes strain information observed among infected cases from the exposure frequencies needed to interpret strain-specific biological vaccine efficacy.
source_refs.author: Peter B. Gilbert, Steven G. Self, Malla Rao, Abdollah Naficy, and John Clemens

source_refs.claim: Shows that repeated exposure and heterogeneous risk can invalidate case-only sieve interpretations based on proportional exposure mechanisms.
source_refs.author: Paul T. Edlefsen
source_refs.venue: Computational and Mathematical Methods in Medicine

source_refs.claim: Identifies relative strain-specific vaccine efficacy from case-only data only under explicit causal assumptions and supplies debiased inference on that point-identified side.
source_refs.author: Lars van der Laan and Peter B. Gilbert

source_refs.excerpt: the general external-margin completeness question and the proper-subset-margin identification frontier remain open
Randomized-arm marginals identify the compatibility threshold, not the latent rowwise distance

open_problems.why_unsolved: The sieve and case-only literatures explain why infecting-strain composition and exposure composition differ and recover relative effects only by adding exposure-mechanism assumptions. The banked external-margin work separately leaves completeness and proper-subset-margin frontiers unresolved. The required first step is to encode the selected case law and independently sampled exposure margin as distinct constraints on one latent history law, then determine exactly when the exposure constraints are redundant for the waning image. Outside that invariance region, necessity requires explicit same-input laws with different waning values, while incompatibility requires a finite separating certificate; verbal case-mix arguments or sufficient independence assumptions do not establish either frontier.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An if-and-only-if invariance and feasibility theorem, attainable sharp distortion bounds, and either compatible-law witnesses or two-law nonidentification certificates when exposure margins are missing or replaced by case frequencies.

writing_exemplar.why: Its formulation clearly separates what infecting strains among cases reveal from the per-exposure biological quantity investigators want.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Breakthrough cases reveal infecting strains -> case composition need not equal exposure composition -> a sharp invariance-and-distortion frontier is required before case frequencies can replace exposure margins.

method_exemplars.technique: Factor exposure, timing, and susceptibility mechanisms and construct counterexamples by violating the proportionality conditions that make case-only comparisons interpretable.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Those factorizations isolate which latent components must cancel for case frequencies and exposure margins to induce the same waning functional.

method_exemplars.technique: Derive a case-only identifying odds ratio under explicit causal assumptions and use targeted debiased estimation with an exact remainder and asymptotic linearity.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies estimator and limit theory on the point-identified side of the desired invariance frontier.

method_exemplars.technique: Calibrate moment-constraint relaxations by bootstrap and project the resulting feasible parameter region onto a nonlinear target.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Sampling uncertainty in both the selected case law and external margins must be propagated through the same feasible-law fiber.

open_problems.open_problem: For changing feasible variant-exposure mixtures, when do all compatible laws agree that a policy-fixed reference-mixture challenge effect wanes, and what is the minimum mixture perturbation permitting a pooled sign reversal?

source_refs.claim: Shows that competing variants can make vaccine-effectiveness measures time-varying and complicate attribution of temporal movement to biological waning.
source_refs.author: Anirudh Tomer and Jorne Biccler

source_refs.claim: Separates true waning from depletion-of-susceptibles bias across epidemiologic regimes.
source_refs.author: Rebecca Kahn, Daniel R. Feikin, Ryan E. Wiegand, and Marc Lipsitch

source_refs.claim: Develops a single-pathogen test of effect constancy and new waning bounds, without changing variant mixtures or a common-law pooled-sign frontier.
source_refs.author: Gellért Perényi, Matias Janvin, and Mats J. Stensrud

a primal optimizer contains an adversarial sign-reversing kernel, and a maximizing basic cut certifies

open_problems.why_unsolved: Existing multi-variant work establishes that aggregation can generate temporal movement, and the challenge-effect literature supplies single-pathogen bounds or null tests. Neither gives necessary and sufficient inequalities for sign robustness under a policy-fixed reference mixture when period mixtures differ and their coupling is latent. The closest prior sign-radius proposal was criticized for defining a minimum radius without an independent dual or observable-cut characterization. Here the obstacle is sharper: the pooled contrast involves reciprocal risks, and separately optimized numerator, denominator, or variant endpoints may require mutually incompatible latent laws. The perturbation must therefore be optimized over one common history law and certified by an attained primal solution, a dual cut, or a no-reversal ray.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient characterization of robust waning, no-waning, and ambiguity regions, plus an exact primal-dual formula for the minimum reference-mixture perturbation causing sign reversal and an explicit infinity branch.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames the destination around competing variants and the danger of interpreting temporal changes in pooled vaccine effectiveness as biological waning.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Several variants compete over follow-up -> pooled effectiveness changes with the variant process and vaccine mechanism -> policy interpretation requires an exact common-law frontier for whether the waning sign is invariant.

method_exemplars.technique: Express early and late challenge effects as counterfactual risk ratios and derive attainable inequalities from observed cumulative risks.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired frontier compares analogous early and late challenge-risk ratios jointly across variants and a common latent law.

method_exemplars.technique: Optimize causal contrasts over latent response-type probabilities and derive observable facets and attainable witnesses from the primal-dual polytope.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The pooled-sign frontier is a projection of a latent-law polytope and cannot be recovered by multiplying coordinatewise intervals.

method_exemplars.technique: Construct a summary-data statistic for a sharp no-waning null and derive its sampling law using incidence-ratio contrasts.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its null-testing machinery is the nearest inferential starting point for testing whether an identified pooled-sign region excludes no waning.

open_problems.open_problem: How can one confidence projection cover the entire sharp reference-mixture waning set and pooled-sign frontier uniformly when trial risks and external exposure margins are jointly estimated and supported histories or active optimization faces can change?

open_problems.why_unsolved: The vaccine-waning anchor supplies endpointwise inference, while Romano–Shaikh distinguish coverage of the whole identified set from coverage of an unknown point and Kaido–Molinari–Stoye treat nonlinear projections under moment restrictions. The accepted transport proposal explicitly leaves uniform inference open when faces and support change. Direct importation fails because reference-mixture endpoints are reciprocal functions of probabilities constrained by an LP, active faces can switch under local perturbations, exposure cells and denominators can approach zero, and trial and exposure margins may come from independent samples. A valid construction must project a joint region for all primitives and preserve infeasible fibers, tied faces, and denominator-boundary behavior instead of attaching scalar Wald intervals to selected endpoints.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A feasible bootstrap or test-inversion procedure with a theorem guaranteeing uniform asymptotic coverage of the full sharp waning set and pooled-sign frontier, including active-face ties, changing support, and near-degenerate denominators.

writing_exemplar.why: It motivates why uncertainty in both sharp bounds matters for deciding whether clinically meaningful waning is present.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: A causal waning effect is only partially identified -> decisions depend on the complete sharp region -> changing variants and estimated exposure margins require whole-set confidence projection rather than separate endpoint intervals.

method_exemplars.technique: Invert a family of membership tests while controlling simultaneous error so the resulting random region contains the entire population identified set uniformly.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The requested coverage target is the complete vaccine-waning set and sign frontier, not one selected parameter value.

method_exemplars.technique: Bootstrap-calibrate relaxations of studentized moment constraints and repeatedly solve feasibility programs while projecting a nonlinear target.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Reference-mixture reciprocal effects are nonlinear projections of probability vectors constrained by equalities and inequalities.

method_exemplars.technique: Estimate a Hadamard directional derivative and resample its pushforward law when max, min, or projection maps are nondifferentiable.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Sharp endpoints and pooled-sign values are nonsmooth at tied active histories, where an ordinary bootstrap can fail.

literature_map:
Gilbert, Self, Rao, Naficy, and Clemens (2001, Journal of Clinical Epidemiology) establish sieve analysis while separating infecting-strain information from unobserved exposure frequencies.
Edlefsen (2014, Computational and Mathematical Methods in Medicine) shows that repeated exposure and risk heterogeneity can invalidate proportional-hazard and case-only sieve interpretations.
Dai, Li, and Gilbert (2014, Biostatistics) develop efficient case-only competing-risks estimation for differential vaccine efficacy under rare failures.
Follmann and Huang (2018, Biometrics) allow multiple infecting pathogens, time-varying efficacy, and time-varying pathogen distributions through a marked-process model.
Benkeser, Juraska, and Gilbert (2020) estimate cumulative-risk sieve trends over pathogen genetic distance.
Follmann, Fay, Magaret, and Gilbert (2022, Statistics in Medicine) combine trial and surveillance strain data, illustrating reliance on externally supplied strain inputs.
Tomer and Biccler (2022, arXiv:2202.06762) show that multi-variant vaccine-effectiveness measures may vary over time even without biological waning.
Van der Laan and Gilbert (2023, arXiv:2303.11462) give causal conditions and debiased inference for relative strain efficacy in case-only studies.
Stensrud and Smith (2023, Epidemiology; arXiv:2111.11548) show that exposure information controls identification of exposure-conditional vaccine effects.
Murayama, Endo, and Yonekura (2023, Epidemics) estimate variant-specific waning from aggregate surveillance, offering rapid but model-dependent analysis.
Janvin and Stensrud (2025, JASA; arXiv:2405.01336) formalize waning as a challenge effect and derive sharp two-period bounds without changing variant mixtures.
Kahn, Feikin, Wiegand, and Lipsitch (2024, AJE) study true versus depletion-induced waning across epidemiologic regimes.
Perényi, Janvin, and Stensrud (2026, AJE; arXiv:2511.21836) develop a powerful no-waning test and additional bounds without a multi-variant reference-mixture frontier.
Balke and Pearl (1997, JASA) provide the latent-response-type LP template for sharp bounds and attainable-law certificates.
Romano and Shaikh (2010, Econometrica) address whole-identified-set coverage; Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye (2019, Econometrica) provide calibrated nonlinear projection under moment inequalities. No located paper combines joint variant-history compression, external exposure margins, reciprocal sharp endpoints, common-law sign frontiers, compatible-law witnesses, and uniform whole-set inference.

Downgraded pid_recurrent_capacity_transport_regret_v1 supplied the common-law lesson that a joint sharp image can be smaller than the product of scalar sharp intervals.
Downgraded scm_selection_externalmargin_complete_id_v1 supplied the unresolved proper-subset external-margin frontier and the need for same-input separating laws after recovery failure.
